name: pi-extensions-workspace
description: Bun workspace for independently published Pi extensions

scripts.build:all: bun run clean:dist && bun run build:packages && bun run build:extensions
scripts.build:packages: bun run --cwd packages/shared-settings build && bun run --cwd packages/workspace-files build
scripts.test: bun run build:all && node --import tsx --test --test-isolation=process tests/shared-settings.test.ts tests/workspace-files.test.ts tests/ssh-remote-servers.test.ts tests/ssh-remote-mappings.test.ts tests/ssh-remote-manifest.test.ts tests/ssh-remote-sync.test.ts tests/ssh-remote-watcher.test.ts tests/ssh-remote-exec.test.ts tests/ssh-remote-mode-integration.test.ts tests/remote-resources.test.ts tests/ssh-remote.test.ts tests/ssh-remote-windows-integration.test.ts tests/packages.test.ts tests/git-install-contract.test.ts
scripts.check: bun run check:privacy && bun run lint && bun run test
scripts.pack:ssh-remote: bun run --cwd extensions/ssh-remote build && bun pm pack --dry-run --cwd dist/ssh-remote
scripts.pack:shared-settings: bun run --cwd packages/shared-settings build && bun pm pack --dry-run --cwd dist/shared-settings
scripts.pack:workspace-files: bun run --cwd packages/workspace-files build && bun pm pack --dry-run --cwd dist/workspace-files
scripts.pack:check: bun run check && bun run pack:shared-settings && bun run pack:workspace-files && bun run pack:ssh-remote

author: aoliyougei
